description: Abstract PHP class defining a base for payment methods in the Goteo project, utilizing the Omnipay library for payment processing. It includes methods for initializing gateways, handling transactions, refunds, and configuration details.

classes.name: AbstractPaymentMethod
classes.description: Helper abstract class providing common functionality for payment methods using Omnipay, including gateway initialization, transaction processing, refunds, and URL generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the user and setting up the payment gateway.

methods.name: initGateway
methods.description: Initializes the payment gateway using Omnipay's GatewayFactory and configures default parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Static method returning the identifier of the payment method class derived from class name.

methods.name: getIdNonStatic
methods.description: Returns the payment method id based on class name, non-static version.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a localized name of the payment method.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns description of the payment method, defaulting to name.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns URL to the icon representing the payment method.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the payment method is active; default implementation always returns true.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Checks if the payment method is public; default implementation always returns true.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User object with the payment method instance.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the associated User object.

methods.name: setInvest
methods.description: Associates an Invest object with the payment method instance.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Invest object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Associates an HTTP Request object for current request context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP Request object.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Provides a default redirect or response after purchase completion; default is null.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates a purchase request through the gateway; returns a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase process after redirect from payment gateway.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates whether refunds are supported; defaults to true if gateway supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Performs a refund through the gateway if supported.

methods.name: getCompleteUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL for completing the transaction based on the type of invest.

methods.name: getInvestDescription
methods.description: Returns a textual description of the investment, including reward if available.

methods.name: getTotalAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of the investment, including donations.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the gateway derived from the class id.

methods.name: getGateway
methods.description: Returns the initialized GatewayInterface instance.

methods.name: calculateCommission
methods.description: Calculates the transaction fee based on configuration, considering refunds.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates whether the payment is internal; default false.

methods.name: isSubscription
methods.description: Indicates whether the payment method is a subscription; default false.
